blocks.text: Cybersecurity
Cybersecurity computers, networks, data aur online accounts ko unauthorized access (be-ijazat rasai), ghalat istemal, nuqsan ya cyberattacks se bachane ka amal hai.
Online Safety
Online safety ka matlab hai zaati maloomat, devices aur digital identity (online pehchan) bachane ke liye Internet ehtiyat aur zimmedari se use karna.
Strong Password (mazboot password)
Mazboot password aisa mehfooz password hai jis ka andaza lagana mushkil ho. Is mein aam taur par bare (uppercase) aur chhote (lowercase) letters, numbers aur symbols mile hote hain.
Privacy Settings
Privacy settings digital platforms par aise options hain jin se user control karta hai ke us ki zaati maloomat, posts, profile, location aur online sargarmi kaun dekh sake.
Privacy Policy
Privacy policy batati hai ke koi application, website ya idara user ka data kaise jama, use, store aur share karta hai.
Digital Collaboration
Digital collaboration ka matlab hai Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams, shared documents, video meetings aur group chats jaise tools se online mil kar kaam karna.
Digital Etiquette (online adaab)
Digital etiquette se murad online baat-cheet karte waqt shaista, izzat wala aur zimmedarana rawaiya hai.
Cyber Threat
Cyber threat digital systems, data ya users ke liye koi bhi mumkin khatra hai. Misalein: phishing, malware, ransomware, hacking aur identity theft.
Phishing
Phishing aisa cyberattack hai jis mein jaali emails, messages ya websites users ko dhoka de kar un se passwords, bank ki tafseel ya zaati maloomat le leti hain.
Malware
Malware nuqsan-deh software hai jo computer ko nuqsan pohanchane, data churane ya system ka aam kaam kharab karne ke liye banaya jata hai.
Ransomware
Ransomware malware ki ek qism hai jo files ya systems ko lock kar deti hai aur dobara rasai dene ke liye paisa mangti hai.
Two-Factor Authentication
Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) security ka tareeqa hai jo do tarah ki tasdeeq mangta hai, jaise password aur mobile phone par bheja gaya code.
Biometric Verification
Biometric verification user ki pehchan confirm karne ke liye munfarid jismani khoobiyan use karti hai, jaise fingerprints, chehre ki pehchan ya awaz ki pehchan.
Firewall
Firewall security ka tool hai jo security rules ke mutabiq network mein aane aur jane wale traffic ki nigrani aur control karta hai.
Antivirus Software
Antivirus software aisa program hai jo computer se viruses aur doosre nuqsan-deh software ko pakarta, rokta aur hatata hai.
Cryptography
Cryptography maloomat ko mehfooz shakal mein badal kar bachane ki technique hai, ta ke sirf authorized (ijazat wale) users hi use parh sakein.
Data Protection
Data protection ka matlab hai zaati, taleemi, idare ki ya hassas maloomat ko zaya hone, ghalat istemal, chori ya unauthorized access se mehfooz rakhna.
Accessibility
Accessibility ka matlab hai digital systems is tarah design karna ke mukhtalif salahiyat, zarooraton aur pas-e-manzar wale log unhein aasani se use kar sakein.
Intellectual Property
Intellectual property se murad zehan ki takhleeqat hain, jaise software, kitabein, tasaveer, videos, designs aur ijadat, jin ke qanooni malik afraad ya idare hote hain.
Data Privacy Laws
Data privacy laws woh qanooni rules hain jo hifazat karte hain ke zaati data kaise jama, store, use aur share ho.
E-Waste
E-waste ka matlab hai phenke gaye electronic devices, jaise purane computers, mobile phones, batteries, printers aur chargers.
Sustainable Computing
Sustainable computing ka matlab hai technology ko is tarah use, design aur thikane lagana ke mahol ko kam nuqsan pohanche.
Entrepreneurship
Entrepreneurship naye (innovative) business khayalat banane, masle hal karne aur technology aur digital platforms se mauqe paida karne ka amal hai.
Digital Entrepreneurship
Digital entrepreneurship mein Internet, social media, e-commerce ya digital tools se karobar ya services banana aur chalana shamil hai.

blocks.text: Kitab ke E-Waste wale jumle mein "electronidevices" chhapa hai; yeh "electronic devices" hai (do alfaaz jur gaye hain).
